## What's new

**Every folder remembers how you liked it.** Sort column and direction, column
widths, and the new **Folders first** checkbox are stored per folder, so a
folder you tuned opens tuned and one you never touched opens with the defaults.
The state lives in `~/.config/roach-explorer/folderViews.json`, most recently
used first and capped at 100 folders. A change is written five seconds after you
stop fiddling, when you leave the folder, or when the window closes — whichever
comes first. Cmd+R re-reads it, so a change made in a second window shows up in
the first.

**Folders first is a toggle.** It sits at the left of the status bar. On, folders
stay pinned above files in every order, as before. Off, folders and files are
mixed and sorted by the active column: Downloads sorted by date now puts the
newest download on top even when it is a file. Unlike the old behaviour, the
switch is part of each folder's saved view, so a normal working folder can keep
folders on top while one download folder mixes them.

**A symlink row says where it goes.** A link gets a second line with its target,
resolved to an absolute path and with your home folder shortened to `~`
(`→ ~/Documents`). Rows with a second line are taller; everything else keeps the
dense 22 pt.

**Free space in the status bar.** The bar now ends with the free space on the
volume behind the open folder (`12 items — 45 GB free`). It uses the same figure
Finder shows, so purgeable space is included.

**The delete confirmation appears next to the pointer.** Delete Immediately used
to centre its dialog on whatever screen the app was on. It now opens beside the
cursor, clamped to the visible screen, the way the Info window already behaved.
The buttons and their Return key are unchanged.

Nothing else changed in this build — no new file operations, no new navigation,
no new shortcuts. The 39 unit tests pass.

## Installing

Download `RoachExplorer-v0.1.4.zip`, unzip it, and drag **Roach Explorer** into
Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed, so the first launch may need
right-click → Open. Verify the download with the SHA-256 file next to it:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c RoachExplorer-v0.1.4.zip.sha256
```

Requires macOS 14 or later.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HenzeLars/RoachExplorer/compare/v0.1.3a...v0.1.4
